goal: Close, verify, commit and publish the current Android baseline, then synchronize it into the Feishu frontend design branch.
non_goals: Do not modify Room schema, DAOs, protocol schemas, import/export payloads or SecretStore behavior.
Do not open production PostgreSQL writes.
Do not build or sign a release APK.
acceptance_criteria: Only NewSessionPrefillRequest remains in the challenge-to-new-session production flow.
ChatComposerLayout and ChatOverflowAction are consumed by production UI.
The AppPreferences extension is isolated, backward-compatible and covered by persistence tests.
Android is clean and pushed after unit tests, lint and assembleDebug pass.
Design-only assets are committed on feat/ux-polish-2026-07-27, not Android.
do_not_touch: Native Room entities, DAOs, schema exports and migrations
notes: The existing preference changes are treated as a separate frozen-layer exception and must be committed with their tests.
The Feishu branch receives the verified Android baseline; main is not changed.
